TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Autonomous run state stores goal, phase, module, objective, status, gates, steps, and outcome fields
Blocked runs require an approved human review before dashboard-driven resume can continue.
Replay events preserve state, gate, step, review, outcome, and evidence references.
Latest handoff metadata and compact agent context are durable and reloadable for resumed work.
Run listing ignores action snapshot JSON files so resume/status survives persisted action plans.
Action queue exposes explicit plan, next action, bounded loop, retry, and replay controls for persisted runs.
Action queue injects PreCommitVerify before final completion and blocks completion when required gates fail.
Phase engine supports dry-run and applied advancement only after active phase gates pass.
Action queue exposes SelfHeal as the next safe action for verification failures unless a diagnosis is already awaiting review.
Scenario runs preserve bounded objective to gates, evidence, review, completion, and replay.
